name: specscribe-analysis-digest
description: Dev-time emitter for the agent-facing analysis digest under .specscribe/analysis/. Fetches this repository's current SonarCloud findings ANONYMOUSLY (IntegerMan_SpecScribe is a public free-tier project — no token is read, written, or required anywhere) and projects them into the ADR 0023 AnalysisObservation contract as a sharded, gitignored digest. Ships NO product code and touches no generated output, so the golden fingerprint cannot move. Zero runtime dependencies.
